title: Agent Configuration File
description: JSON configuration file with all settings you might want to change without editing code: provider URL, model, temperature, history path, skill path, allowed commands, and logging.

steps.description: Provider settings: URL, API key, model, and temperature for the LLM.
File paths: history_path for memory, log_level for verbosity.
Skill_path: points to the SKILL.md file for the agent's instructions.
Command safety: allowed_commands list, timeout, and max commands per turn.
